Exact takeaway:先讓關鍵動作進入輸入，再驗證影片模型的判斷。
For flow comparison use SAME L-shaped flat silver part in reference, all valid arrows BLUE rightwards; red reserved only error example. For video sampling choose the exact first and last frames of full clip; slipped object only in omitted middle frame.
